title: UCC Codes: UCC 1-308 Without Prejudice Sign this way & don't contract! The UCC Book to read! Private
summary: Promoter walks through the UCC book, telling viewers to sign with UCC 1-308 without prejudice and that negotiable instruments can wipe out debts.

assertions.quote: without prejudice means that I'm holding my own rights and that I'm not giving away anything
promissory notes will are what you can use to write off debts whether public or private
you'll find sections where it's been stricken and re-written or moved because people start using it

verdicts.note: It moved in the 2001 revision of UCC Article 1 as part of a general renumbering, not to block users.
The section was indeed formerly 1-207, but the official comment says it is 'identical to former Section 1-207', so the renumbering changed nothing and gives no sign of an aim to stop its use.

assertions.quote: you have three legal days to refuse any contract
